Perfect! All 126 tests now pass. 

**Root cause:** The `bulk_discount` function in `shopcart/pricing.py` was using `>` (strictly greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to) when checking if quantity meets the bulk threshold. This meant the discount was only applied when quantity was *above* the threshold (11+), not *at* the threshold (10).

**Fix:** Changed line 14 from `if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:` to `if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD:` to correctly apply the 10% bulk discount when purchasing
